    try {
        var number = request.pathParams.number;

        if (gs.nil(number)) {
            response.setStatus(400);
            response.setBody({ error: 'Missing required parameter: number' });
            return;
        }

        var service = new ProjectMCPProjectService();
        var result = service.getByNumber(number);

        if (!result.success) {
            response.setStatus(result.status || 404);
            gs.error('project.get_details service error: ' + result.error);
            response.setBody({ error: 'Request failed. See server logs for details.' });
            return;
        }

        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(result.data);

    } catch (e) {
        gs.error('project.get_details error: ' + e.message);
        response.setStatus(500);
        response.setBody({ error: 'Internal error processing request' });
    }
})(request, response);]]></operation_script><operation_uri/><produces/><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/project/{number}</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Retrieve project core fields and related table map.</short_description><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>MCPAdmin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-29 02:25:31</sys_created_on><sys_id>9f868c7e2b6f0b1035a8f22ffe91bf0f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Get Project Details</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Project MCP Server" source="x_snc_project_mc_0">51aed7e62bef4b10ff25f5bc4e91bf6b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Project MCP Server">51aed7e62bef4b10ff25f5bc4e91bf6b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_9f868c7e2b6f0b1035a8f22ffe91bf0f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>MCPAdmin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-29 02:25:31</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition/><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
